reason: The only candidate is Hans Jurie Lombard. That given name clearly contradicts Hermanus Anthonie, so the shared surname and Albany district are not enough.
C06 is Willem Petrus Prinsloo of Somerset, an exact match for both given names and the declared district. No other candidate shares both names.
The candidates are Willem Jacobus and Jacob van Straten. Neither name is compatible with Francois Cornelius.
No Somerset or Graaff-Reinet Venter owner is named Paulus Christoffel or any variant of it. C21 (Marcus Albertus, son of Paul) is at most a son, not this man.
The Swellendam candidates are Gert Petrus and Isaac Bartolomeus. Neither is compatible with Johannes Paulus; their fathers' names only suggest relatives.

C07 is Philip Rudolph Nel of Somerset, an exact full-name and district match. C11 (Philip, son of Louis) is consistent with the father Louis Jacobus and may be the same man, but C07 matches both given names.
C02 is Jacobus Daniel Venter of Beaufort, an exact match for given names and district. The other Beaufort candidates have different names.
No candidate is named Daniel Rudolph Janse. C03 Lucas Daniel (son of Daniel) and the Johannes Janse owners have conflicting first names, and C01 is a widow.
The Jordaan candidates are Gerrit (a deceased estate), Gideon, Johannes Petrus and Pieter Johannes. None is compatible with David Benjamin.

C03 Gert Matthys Jacobus matches the names, but its '+' marks it as deceased (as with C06 Hendrik Christoffel +), while this man lived until 1859. C08 Gerrit Jacobus has a different second name, and C01 'Gerrit sr' fits poorly for a man born in 1804.
